How to play

One camera. One dance. Everyone gets a turn.

  1. Set the stage

    Pick Team Play for 2–4 players. Enable your camera, step back until your whole body fits, and choose a song.

  2. REC ♪

    Make a move

    The round creator starts the countdown and has 10 seconds to record a dance everyone can copy.

  3. 321

    Copy the dance

    When your name comes up, watch the creator’s replay. After 3–2–1, copy their moves. The timer ends your take automatically.

  4. 213✦

    Take the top spot

    Everyone gets a round as creator. The highest average copy score wins. Stick around for the breaking-news replay.

Flying solo? Pick Solo Play to practice a take with the camera and music.
